evidence: For molybdenum nitride deposition from 2 and ammonia, the pulse times were optimized. In Figure 3a), optimization plots for the Mo precursor and ammonia are presented. For Mo precursor optimization, the ammonia pulse was fixed at 6 s. As can be seen, maximum growth per cycle, 0.5 A˚, is achieved with an Mo precursor pulse of 4 s. When the pulse time is elongated to 5 s, growth per cycle is decreased. This is probably caused by insufficient precursor vapor pressure, since the same effect was found in a previous study with a dimethylamido precursor1 for lower precursor evaporation temperatures.
